install: set -euo pipefail; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libasound2-dev libudev-dev pkg-config libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev; fi; if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustup component add rustfmt clippy; fi; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export RUST_MIN_STACK=16777216' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; if [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then cargo fetch; fi
